# Frederikshavn

Frederikshavn is a Danish municipality (kommune) mentioned once in the AFDK 2024 report as part of "Klynge NORD" (Cluster NORTH), one of the geographic health clusters participating in the AFDK program (Atrieflimren i Danmark), the Danish national quality program for atrial fibrillation care [^src1]. The mention appears within a chapter documenting Indicator 8 (Structured patient education), which includes a geographic overview of the Danish health clusters taking part in the program [^src1].

No further relationships, claims, or timeline events involving Frederikshavn are present in the corpus. This is a thin entity page: the single mention establishes only its cluster affiliation within the AFDK program's regional organization.
